_note: Ground truth for scenarios/dev/*. Written before any diagnosis logic exists. NEVER read by runtime code. IDs come from scenarios/topology.json.

normal.json.why: All metrics within range and service checks pass

false_report.json.why: User complains about slow Wi-Fi but every fresh measurement is normal

congestion.json.why: Uplink utilization sustained >90% with rising queue drops and high latency from two sources

weak_wifi.json.why: Low RSSI plus high retries while the AP uplink is healthy

interface_fault.json.why: Interface errors rising with downstream packet loss and normal utilization

dns_failure.json.why: DNS lookups fail from several clients while IP reachability to the server is fine

dhcp_failure.json.why: DHCP leases fail from several clients while the server is reachable

ambiguous_congestion_errors.json.why: High utilization and rising interface errors at once; a QUERY must weaken one rival and the report keeps interface_fault as the alternative

missing_stale.json.why: Key metrics missing or older than the window; the system must abstain, not guess

unit_mismatch.json.why: Latency arrives as rtt_sec and throughput in kbps; after conversion it is congestion

counter_reset.json.why: Error counter drops to zero (device reboot); the negative delta is a reset, not a fault

schema_0_9.json.why: A finding arrives in the old 0.9 format, is upgraded with a visible record, and still counts

unsupported_2_x.json.why: The only fault finding is a 2.0 message; it is rejected with a typed ERROR and the rest is not enough

missing_message_field.json.why: A key FINDING has no stance; it is rejected with field_path payload.stance

duplicate_message.json.why: The same FINDING is sent twice; the copy is ignored and logged and the diagnosis is unchanged

correlation_timeout.json.why: Correlation fails after a retry; the orchestrator reports with limitation correlation_failed

malformed_input.json.why: The telemetry file is not valid JSON; the report has validation_errors and confidence null

_changes: 1.1 (Phase 3): affected_ids of ambiguous_congestion_errors and schema_0_9 now include the device the faulty link feeds, consistent with the other link-fault labels (rule fixed in docs/PHASE3_TASKS.md before the first Phase 3 run). No status or cause changed.
